items.q: Bob Greir, another American Negro who had been in Paris for some time, was Jimmy's partner...

ctx.x: Jimmy Monroe, who was the brother of Clark Monroe who had a famous club in Harlem, was in France because his wife Nina Mae McKinney who had starred in the first all-Negro movie produced in Hollywood "Halleluiah" was working in London, but Jimmy could not get permission to stay there and could only visit there for a few days at a time.

Jimmy opened a club in a small street called Cite Pigalle. Spider and his wife lived in this street and also Joe Hayman and wife. Bob Greir, another American Negro who had been in Paris for some time, was Jimmy's partner and the club, which I was told had never been a success for anyone that had ever tried to run it before, became a big success and meeting place for most Americans that were in Paris, and there were plenty of them. The club featured the latest jazz records and became a rendezvous place for…

One night I came home from work and Beezie was not home. We had put Joan in a private school a little outside of Paris shortly after we came from Belgium. Beezie didn't come home until about 8 o'clock that morning and when I asked her where she had been, she told me she was at Jimmy's place with Mae and Spider.
